purpose: Overview of recruitment metrics and key actions.
workflow: Navigate to Dashboard to view your overall pipeline health and click Quick Actions to jump directly to common tasks.
Go to Jobs → Click Create Job → Fill Job Details → Configure Interview Rounds → Submit for approval.

purpose: Manage candidate profiles and their applications.
workflow: Go to Candidates to view all applicants. Click a candidate to view their profile, assigned jobs, and progress.
Navigate to Schedule → Click Schedule Interview → Select Candidate → Select Interviewers → Choose Date & Time → Generate Meeting Link → Save.

purpose: Launch and manage automated assessments and interviews.
workflow: Navigate to Interviews → Launch Interview → Select Job Requisition → Select Workflow Round → Select Candidates → Choose Question Bank → Generate Interview Link.

purpose: Aggregate interviewer feedback and finalize hiring decisions.
workflow: Navigate to Reviews -> View panel feedback -> Discuss consensus -> Record final decision (Pass, Hold, or Fail).

purpose: Final administrative review before extending an offer.
workflow: Navigate to HR Approval -> Select Candidate -> Review Interviewer Recommendations -> Click Approve to automatically generate offer letter.
Navigate to Offers -> Review Generated Offer -> Confirm Details -> Send Email.
